name: application-bullet-chart
title: Bullet Chart
description: Single-metric bullet graph with qualitative background bands (e.g. poor/satisfactory/good), a value bar, and a target marker, all computed from real numbers as percentages of a shared max.
useWhen: Comparing a single metric's actual value against both a target and qualitative performance ranges in one compact row.
You need more context than a plain progress bar — e.g. showing what counts as "poor" vs "good" alongside the value.
Displaying several of these stacked in a list for a KPI scorecard.
avoidWhen: You only need a simple percent-complete indicator with no target or qualitative bands — use progress-bars instead.
You're comparing multiple metrics over time — use charts (line/bar) instead.
The qualitative bands don't apply to your metric — a plain stat-tile or big-number-delta-tile is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The chart bar is a fluid-width block; band, value, and target positions are percentage-based so the chart scales with its container.
accessibility: Each band, the value bar, and the target marker carry role='img' with an aria-label stating the exact number they represent, since position/width alone isn't announced by screen readers.
Qualitative band labels are always shown as visible text below the chart, not conveyed by shade alone.
The target marker is a distinct dark tick mark, not reliant on color to be distinguishable from the value bar.

variants.title: Bullet chart
variants.description: CSAT metric (72 vs 85 target) over Poor/Satisfactory/Good qualitative bands, on a light surface.
accessibility: Band shade alone is supplementary; each band's aria-label and the visible legend text carry the meaning.

variants.title: Bullet chart (Dark)
variants.description: The same CSAT metric, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Band, value bar, and target marker colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
